verdictStatement: All five claimed repairs are genuine and complete, and I verified each at the bytes. The abort target is no longer an undeclared token: to is 'same-or-named' with a structured toFunction giving kind, ordered candidates, else and never, and its candidate order matches statePrecedence exactly. requiredOnRecoverCommit grew from four conjuncts to seven, adding precisely the three I said were missing — recoveryAuthorityApplication, recoveryAuthorityThreshold, oldRootNewRootRoleBinding — with cardinalities reserved. The refusal-reason mapping is now total: I counted producers for all thirteen vocabulary members and none is orphaned, closing both the ENVELOPE-INACTIVE and CONTINUE-REPLAY-NOT-DESIGNED gaps. The dropped Codex v3 advisory is recorded as CODEX-V3-A1 and genuinely folded rather than merely carried. The machine remains total and disjoint and the continuation table still resolves all 343 triples with three permissive outcomes, all requiring CORE=ST-TRUSTED. What withholds acceptance is narrow and was created by this generation: two fixture classes were not updated alongside the rows they cover, and one of them now states an expectation that contradicts the row it fixtures.

shouldFix.title: Two fixture classes were not updated alongside the v5 repairs they cover; one now contradicts its row

instanceOne.measurement: FC-REPLAY-NAMED is byte-identical to v4 and reads 'A named deferred vector for newly revoked replay. Expected: not designed; rides DR-113. Not an executable continue.' The row it covers was retyped by this generation's CODEX-V4-A1 repair and now reads alreadyRunning 'refuse', newProcess 'refuse', outcome 'refused', refusalReason 'CONTINUE-REPLAY-NOT-DESIGNED', with a note that says in terms 'Typed refusal, not an undesigned hole.' The fixture's stated expectation and the row's own note are direct opposites: one expects 'not designed', the other insists it is not undesigned.
instanceOne.consequence: A harness written from FC-REPLAY-NAMED would assert an undesigned disposition and fail against a row that yields a typed refusal. DR-112's acceptance cell requires fixtures, so a fixture that disagrees with the contract row it covers is a defect in the evidence half of the row, not only in prose.
instanceOne.counterReadingRecorded: 'Expected: not designed' could be read as shorthand for the expected reason rather than the expected outcome, since the reason code is literally CONTINUE-REPLAY-NOT-DESIGNED. I record that reading so the coordinator can weigh it, but the row's note was written specifically to deny the undesigned characterisation, and 'Not an executable continue' already carries the safety point, so the phrase is doing outcome work in the fixture.

instanceTwo.measurement: requiredOnRecoverCommit gained three conjuncts in this generation. FC-RECOVERY-AUTHORITY is byte-identical to v4 and vectors only two things: a self-signed replacement root without a valid application of recoveryAuthoritySet, and a commit that identifies no old root when one exists. Neither recoveryAuthorityThreshold nor oldRootNewRootRoleBinding has a vector. FC-TRUST-POLICY covers a generic 'threshold-failure' for the ordinary trust predicate, not the distinct reserved recovery threshold.
instanceTwo.consequence: Two newly-minted mandatory conjuncts on the most safety-sensitive transition in the machine enter the contract without a fixture that would catch their omission. This is weaker than instance one — nothing is contradicted, only uncovered — but it is the same root cause and the same one-line class of fix.

shouldFix.whyThisIsTheRightSeverity: It is not a blocker. Both rows behave fail-closed, the replay row refuses rather than permits, and no permissive path or undetermined outcome exists anywhere I could construct. But this generation amended two fixtures (FC-ENVELOPE-INACTIVE, which correctly dropped its 'or equivalent' hedge, and FC-RECOVER-ABORT) precisely so the fixtures would match the repaired rows, and then left two others behind. The artifact's own newly-appended reviewGuidance line invites this attack — 'Attack the replay continuation row as undesigned rather than CONTINUE-REPLAY-NOT-DESIGNED' — and the row survives that attack while its fixture does not.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Amend FC-REPLAY-NAMED to expect a typed fail-closed refusal carrying CONTINUE-REPLAY-NOT-DESIGNED and riding DR-113, keeping 'Not an executable continue'. Amend FC-RECOVERY-AUTHORITY with two vectors: a commit whose recovery signers do not meet the reserved recovery threshold refuses, and a commit whose old-root/new-root/role binding is absent or mismatched refuses. Keep every cardinality and identity reserved as they are today.
